sections.title: Connie *Rule*
body: Connie's Framing is a full-service custom frame shop in Aiken, owned by Connie Rule.
Alongside the framing, the shop carries artwork by local artists.

items.q: Can you frame an object, not just a picture?
items.a: Yes. Shadow boxes display keepsakes and antique pieces with depth.

items.q: Can I just bring my piece in?
items.a: Call (803) 643-3696 to ask about your piece, or bring it by the shop.

sections.title: Have something worth framing?
sections.text: Bring it to Connie's on Pendleton Street.

before: No working website: the address some directories give, conniesframing.homestead.com, now sends visitors to Homestead's own home page
Directories disagree on the shop's address (Pendleton Street NW, Pendleton Street SW or Park Avenue)
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the shop controls
after: A site the shop owns, at its own address
The right address, phone and map in one obvious place
A gallery of finished frames, the best advertising a frame shop has
Room for local artists' work as the shop supplies it
